verdict.line: You lose if Kled lands Q (Bear Trap) into E (Jousting) before you have R online; you win if you survive to level 6+ and punish him every time Skaarl's HP bar empties.

brief.thesis: Kled's entire kit is an aggression package backed by Skaarl's extra health bar: Q (Bear Trap) yanks you in, E (Jousting) closes the gap, and W (Violent Tendencies) turns the follow-up autos into a burst — which is why he holds the lane and solo-kill edge over a 79-game sample (46.8% Tahm Kench win rate). Tahm's answers (Q stacks toward a stun, W as a reactive knockup, R as an execute) all come online later or require stacks, so this lane is about denying his all-in windows until your health-scaling catches up.

theirWindow.when: Skaarl mounted with Q and E up
theirWindow.what: He dashes in with E (Jousting), hooks with Q (Bear Trap) to yank you the rest of the way, then unloads W (Violent Tendencies) autos. Hold your Thick Skin (E) shield for this exact sequence instead of popping it early.

yourWindow.what: Dismounted, Kled deals less champion damage and his Q is replaced by the weaker Pocket Pistol. Walk up and start landing Tongue Lash (Q) hits toward the 3-stack stun, or Devour (R) him outright if he's caught alone.

start.why: 51.4% win rate over 70 games as the clear majority pick — the regen and block tick absorb Kled's early auto-reliant poke and soften the Q hook trade.

boots.why: 73.1% pick rate; flat damage reduction specifically cuts down the four empowered autos from W (Violent Tendencies), his main source of burst in the all-in.

core.why: Builds the health total that scales both An Acquired Taste damage and Thick Skin's shield size.
Measured 71.4-83.3% win rate as the second item across the top core paths on this patch.
83.3% win rate over 6 games as third item; grievous wounds and the reflect punish his W attack-speed steroid directly.
100% win rate over 3 games following Thornmail; stacks magic sustain on top of Thick Skin's heal-while-out-of-combat passive.

situational.when: he is snowballing off early W (Violent Tendencies) all-ins and you need the anti-heal and armor sooner
the lane is dragging and you need more sustain to out-tank his extended trades

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the health stacking this matchup wants and chips him every time you tap him with Tongue Lash (Q) or trade autos, which is the highest-pick page on this patch (49.5%).

summoners.why: Highest-pick combo on this patch (56.4% pick, 49.1% win rate); Flash answers a committed E (Jousting) dash and Ignite secures the kill once you've opened him up in the dismount window.

playing.title: Hold Thick Skin for his burst
playing.detail: E (Thick Skin) only shields when you activate it — bank the stored damage and pop it right as he lands Q (Bear Trap) into E (Jousting), not before.

playing.title: Punish every dismount
playing.detail: Once Skaarl's HP bar empties, his champion damage drops and Pocket Pistol replaces his hook. Walk up immediately and start stacking Tongue Lash (Q).

playing.title: Respect Jousting's reset
playing.detail: E (Jousting) has 550 range and can be recast to dash back through you for a second hit — don't stand still in front of him once both charges are up.

playing.title: Poke with Q, don't commit
playing.detail: Tongue Lash heals you on champion hit and stacks An Acquired Taste for free — throw it at 900 range whenever he closes without his cooldowns up.

playing.title: Save W for his all-in
playing.detail: Abyssal Dive knocks up and damages everything in the landing area — use it reactively to disengage when he dives with Q/E, not to initiate.

playing.title: Devour him when isolated
playing.detail: At 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, R (Devour) removes him from the fight outright for its duration — look for this especially right after he dismounts.

playing.title: Don't force fights before 6
playing.detail: Without R online you have no answer to his Q-hook into W-burst combo — play for sustain and wave state in the first five levels instead.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and win-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch (OP.GG samples noted inline); the power-curve timing and trade-pattern reasoning are my own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Attack Kled when he closes in using (E). As Kled can gain the upper hand with (P), try to kill him once he dismounts Skaal.
